message.content: The old status page keeps breaking. Replace it with something better for watching the servers.

content.text: I removed the status page container and set up Grafana with a Prometheus data source instead. The dashboards show CPU, memory and disk for every host.

message.content: Can it alert me when a disk is almost full?

content.text: Yes. I added an alert rule that fires when a filesystem is over 90 percent full for ten minutes.
